title: Very sensitive vapor-cell quasi-DC atomic E-field sensor
summary: We report several technical approaches that significantly improve the performance of a vapor-cell atomic electrometer operating in the quasi-DC frequency domain ($\ll$ 1 kHz). With a very small active volume of approximately 11 mm$^3$ inside the vapor cell, we demonstrated a noise floor for electric field (E-field) sensitivity ranging from 0.2 to 7.7 mV/m$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for a frequency band of 1--100 Hz.
